artworks.title: Early Morning, Battersea
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a river scene with a busy harbor. The horizon line is in the upper third of the image, featuring industrial buildings and chimneys. The etching shows detailed textures in the water reflections and architecture. A boat is moored on the river bank, with other boats on the water. Figures are engaging in activities along the waterway. The color palette is sepia-toned, and the sky has dynamic lines indicating movement or clouds.

artworks.title: Jo
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a person in a frontal position with their head slightly turned to the right. The person's facial features are depicted with fine lines, including pronounced cheekbones, a straight nose, and full lips. Their long, wavy hair cascades around their face and shoulders, shown with thick lines. The clothing is hinted at with linear strokes, potentially indicating a draped garment. The background features cross-hatching and line work for shading, with no distinct features, emphasizing the person as the main focus.

artworks.title: The Storm
artworks.medium: drypoint on pale green laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with the horizon slightly above the center line, where the sky meets distant trees and shrubs. A figure is walking across an open field on the left side. The artwork is created using drypoint etching with a monochromatic color palette of varying shades of gray and black. The sky is depicted with vigorous strokes indicating movement, while the landscape below is more delicately rendered.

artworks.title: F. R. Leyland
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and open bite on "japon mince" paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright, with one hand on his hip and the other arm resting at his side. He has distinct facial features, including a beard, and a serious expression. His hair is short and neat. The man is dressed in formal attire. The background is textured with shaded areas, giving the scene an abstract feel.

artworks.title: The Silk Dress
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an illustrated woman in a side profile view. She is standing and facing sideways with a slight turn of her head towards the viewer. The woman has short hair, a hat, and wears a long dress with a fitted bodice and full skirt. The sketch has minimal facial details but shows a focused expression. The background is simple with no additional elements present.

artworks.title: Tillie: A Model
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a figure in profile standing with hands on their knees. The person has softly drawn facial features, slightly lowered eyes, and short swept-back hair. They are nude with no visible clothing or accessories. The background is plain with sketch lines accentuating the figure.

artworks.title: A Child on a Couch, No.2
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person lying on their side with their head on a cushioned surface. The person is reclining with their upper body facing right and their legs extended to the left. Their facial features are relaxed, with closed eyes and a calm expression. The person has short, styled hair and wears a long-sleeved garment. A piece of jewelry is visible on their wrist. The background is simple, suggesting an indoor setting. The style is loose and expressive with quick, linear strokes typical in etching.

artworks.title: Agnes
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched depiction of a woman with a full body view. She is seated, slightly angled towards the left, with her hands resting on her lap. She is holding a piece of fabric or similar object. The woman's facial features are delicately drawn, with softened expressions. She has short hair that is partially covered by a head covering, possibly a bonnet or headscarf. Her clothing consists of a long dress with structured shoulders and a high collar. She is not wearing any noticeable jewelry. The background of the image is plain, with light streaks and speckles.

artworks.title: The Scotch Widow
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length seated individual. The person is turned slightly to the side with their head inclined downwards. They wear a headscarf covering the hair and a layered shawl over their shoulders. The person has softly defined facial features indicating a contemplative expression. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is minimal, with an empty space emphasizing the person in the foreground.

artworks.title: Speke Hall, No.2
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a row of traditional-style houses with intricate detailing in a fine etching technique. The buildings have a Tudor style with gabled roofs and chimneys. The coloring is monochromatic with delicate contrast between dark lines and a light background. Trees are depicted with minimal details on the right, and there is an indistinct area indicating a pathway or garden at the base of the buildings.

artworks.title: The Troubled Thames
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water with a cityscape or industrial skyline in the background. The horizon is high in the composition, with various structures, possibly factory buildings with smokestacks. The brushstrokes are sketch-like and linear, and cross-hatching is used for shading and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia tones and shades of black. There are boats on the water with masts and forms depicted in quick strokes, and detailed outlines of buildings in the distance.

artworks.title: The Tiny Pool
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a waterside view with various masts and structures. The horizon line is high, and there are buildings and tall masts in the distance. The lines in the etching are delicate, creating a detailed appearance. The color scheme is sepia-toned. Several boats are moored, and two figures are standing by the water. A busy harbor can be seen in the distance, maintaining an open atmosphere.

artworks.title: Old Battersea Bridge
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden bridge extending over water. The bridge is detailed with long planks and pilings. People and small structures are visible on the bridge. In the background, there is a sailboat and buildings on the far shore. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic palette, typical of etchings, creating a timeless feel.

artworks.title: The Traghetto, No.I
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a courtyard scene with an archway leading deeper into the space. The perspective is from the front looking through the archway into the enclosed courtyard. The composition focuses on the arch and surrounding walls. The etching has varied delicate brushstrokes with cross-hatching for texture, particularly under the arch. The artwork uses a monochrome color palette, primarily gray, for light and shadow contrasts. There is a paved floor leading under the arch, and a tree with sparse leaves reaching upward. The walls have windows with cross-hatched panes, and the interior walls enclose the courtyard.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Man
artworks.medium: black chalk, heightened with white, on brown paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 19.7 x 23.9 cm (7 3/4 x 9 7/16 in.)
support: 22.2 x 26.5 cm (8 3/4 x 10 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Sarah Margaret McCormick
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of a person's face, revealing only the upper portion of the individual's head from the nose upwards, with the forehead slightly visible. The person is gazing upward with eyes partially closed. The facial features include a prominent forehead, deep-set eyes, and high cheekbones. The person's hair is long and flowing, blending into a substantial beard that extends downward. The drawing is monochromatic, created using a sketching technique. There is no visible clothing or additional objects shown. The background is a plain, textured brown surface.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child on the Crescent
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length figure of a person holding a baby in their arms. The person is positioned facing forward, gazing towards the baby, and dressed in a flowing robe and a helmet-like headpiece adorned with a radiating design. The facial features of the person appear solemn, with shadowed eyes and a sharp nose. The baby is nestled in the person's arms, with chubby features and a gaze directed towards the person holding it. Both figures are surrounded by a series of concentric circles that emanate outward, creating a halo effect around them. In the lower-left corner, the year '1520' is inscribed along with the initials 'ISP'. The background is a textured surface with lines radiating outward.

artworks.title: Study of a Man's Head with a Full Beard
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with red chalk and graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed artistic drawing of the head and upper torso of an older male figure in profile. The person faces left with his head slightly angled downwards, emphasizing his facial features. He has a prominent nose, deep-set eye sockets, wrinkles, a long beard, and long, graying hair. The man wears a simple garment, suggested by lines around his shoulders. The background is plain with some spots and blemishes.

artworks.title: Head of a Man, Full Face
artworks.medium: graphite and black chalk with brown wash, heightened with white, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a close-up view of a man's head and partial upper body. The man has a full beard and moustache, and his facial features are detailed, with closed eyes. His hair is medium-length and slightly wavy, framing his face and extending to his ears. The man's clothing is in dark tones, blending with the textured, warm brown background. Light and shadow accentuate the contours of his face, giving the image a three-dimensional quality. No jewelry or additional objects are visible.

artworks.title: Clap of Thunder [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite  on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with expressive brushstrokes depicting trees, figures, and foliage. The color palette is earthy with shades of brown and sepia. Two figures are visible near tall, twisting trees.

artworks.title: Crowd of People Seen between Two Columns [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black  chalk on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a crowded scene with multiple figures closely gathered together. The figures are depicted in swift, broad strokes suggesting movement and interaction. Varying shades of brown are used for depth and contrast. Two vertical lines are included in the composition, potentially representing pillars. The atmosphere is energetic and slightly somber, with a monochromatic color palette and fluid lines.

artworks.title: Head of a Man  (Possible Portrait of Professor E.D. Adams)
artworks.medium: black and red chalk with yellow-green crayon, heightened with white, over graphite on orange-pink prepared paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a portrait sketch of a man with a mustache and short hair, facing forward. His facial features include a prominent brow and defined lips, with a neutral expression and eyes looking straight ahead. The sketch showcases the texture of his facial hair and hair on his head. The background is plain peach, and the drawing fades out towards the neck. There are no visible clothing, accessories, or objects in the image. The sketch is signed "A. Legros" in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Mab and Cupid (Mab et Cupidon)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a seated baby and an adult facing each other. The baby is sitting upright with its head slightly turned to the viewer's right. The baby has curly hair and is depicted without clothing. The adult is reclining beside the baby, with long, wavy hair, wearing a head wrap or similar fabric. The adult's expression appears calm, with closed lips and eyes looking towards the baby. The scene is set against a textured background. In the lower left corner, the initials "A.L." are visible, and the artist's signature "A. Legros" is written below the scene.

artworks.title: Broken Cart (La charette brisee)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated person with a bearded face and a hood covering their head. They are wearing a long, draping garment and holding onto a cane or stick. Beside them is an overturned wooden wheelbarrow with a wheel. The background includes grass or vegetation, and the initials "A.L." are visible in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Auguste Rodin
artworks.medium: etching in brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a detailed drawing of a man's head and neck in profile view. The man has an angular face with pronounced features, a long, full beard, short hair combed back, and a light and wispy texture. He appears to be dressed in a high-collared garment. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is a plain, light-colored surface with subtle texture, focusing on the man's facial profile.
